RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG="Saved print file: {print_file}"

gcode_macro _show_tool_change_status.gcode:
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG="Fetching tool change status..."
RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=get_tool_change_status

gcode_macro _track_tool_change.gcode:
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG="Processing tool change..."
RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=update_tool_change

gcode_macro _save_filament_sensor_state.description: Save the current enabled state of filament

gcode_macro _restore_filament_sensor_sta.description: Restore the previously saved filament sensor states

gcode_macro _get_filament_sensor_state.description: Display the currently saved filament sensor states

gcode_macro set_pause_next_layer.description: Enable a pause if the next layer is reached

gcode_macro set_pause_at_layer.description: Enable/disable a pause if a given layer number is reached

gcode_macro set_print_stats_info.description: Overwrite, to get pause_next_layer and pause_at_layer feature

gcode_macro _toolhead_park_pause_cancel.description: Helper: park toolhead used in PAUSE and CANCEL_PRINT

gcode_macro _client_extrude.description: Extrudes, if the extruder is hot enough

gcode_macro _client_retract.description: Retracts, if the extruder is hot enough

gcode_macro _client_linear_move.description: Linear move with save and restore of the gcode state

gcode_macro line_purge.description: A purge macro that adapts to be near your actual printed objects

gcode_macro voron_purge.description: A purge macro that adapts to be near your actual printed objects

gcode_macro smart_park.description: Parks your printhead near the print area for pre-print hotend heating.

gcode_macro _kamp_settings.gcode: {action_respond_info(" Running the KAMP_Settings macro does nothing, it is only used for storing KAMP settings. ")}
gcode_macro _kamp_settings.description: This macro contains all adjustable settings for KAMP

filament_switch_sensor switch_sensor.insert_gcode:
M117 Filament loaded
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Filament Detected'

filament_motion_sensor encoder_sensor.insert_gcode:
M117 Filament motion detected
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Filament Motion Detected'

gcode_macro pause_after_d.description: Pause print after extruding D mm more filament

gcode_macro cancel_delayed_pause.gcode:
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=PAUSE_AT_D DURATION=0
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=PAUSE_AFTER_D VARIABLE=end_d VALUE=0
M117 Delayed pause cancelled
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Delayed pause cancelled'

gcode_macro attach_probe_lock.description: Attaches Klack Probe, can only be docked after unlocking

gcode_macro dock_probe_unlock.description: Docks Klack Probe even if it was locked

gcode_macro _probe_unlock.gcode:
_KlackDebug msg="_Probe_Lock setting probe_lock variable to False"
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_Probe_Variables VARIABLE=probe_lock VALUE={ False }

gcode_macro _probe_lock.gcode:
_KlackDebug msg="_Probe_Lock setting probe_lock variable to True"
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_Probe_Variables VARIABLE=probe_lock VALUE={ True }

gcode_macro probe_calibrate.description: Calibrate the probes z_offset with Klack automount

gcode_macro probe_accuracy.description: Probe Z-height accuracy at current XY position with Klack automount
